skill.name: sketchbook-style
skill.description: Create industrial design sketchbook images with four ink styles, image generation scripts, monochrome post-processing, and measurable style targets.
skill.summary: Turn machines and gadgets into pen, marker, heavy-ink, or varied-line sketchbook pages.
skill.author: keith-cy

security_audit.summary: Most static flags match drawing terminology, Markdown backticks, Chinese documentation, or expected local rendering operations. Confirmed risks concern unvalidated job names escaping the output directory and predictable shared locks allowing local denial of service. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential theft, or intentional data exfiltration in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Unvalidated job names in scripts/comfygen.py can redirect image and metadata writes outside the selected output directory.
remediation.suggestion: Reject absolute paths, separators, and parent traversal in job names. Verify resolved destinations remain inside the output directory and create files without following symlinks.

remediation.issue: Both generation scripts trust a predictable shared lock path without verifying directory ownership or limiting lock waits.
remediation.suggestion: Use an owner-verified lock in a private runtime directory with restrictive permissions. Add bounded waits and reject lock entries owned by another user.

content.value_statement: Generic image prompts often produce polished illustrations instead of quick industrial design sketches. This skill combines four style variants, rendering settings, ink post-processing, and measurements for more consistent sketchbook pages.
actual_capabilities: Build prompts for pen, marker, heavy-ink, and varied-line contrast styles.
Compose object studies, construction studies, annotated pages, thumbnail collections, and simple scenes.
Submit Qwen-Image 2.1 jobs to a configured ComfyUI server and save images with generation metadata.
Run local FLUX.2 klein or Z-Image Turbo fallbacks through installed mflux commands.
Apply monochrome ink processing with stroke thickening, wobble, dry-brush edges, or density-based line weights.

faq.question: Can I use this skill with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: The instructions support Agent Skills hosts, including Claude Code and Codex. Rendering also requires script execution and access to a configured image engine.

faq.question: Which image engine should I configure?
faq.answer: The skill recommends Qwen-Image 2.1 through ComfyUI. Local fallbacks use mflux with FLUX.2 klein or Z-Image Turbo on Apple Silicon.

faq.question: Does the skill need an API key?
faq.answer: The included scripts do not require an API key. You must provide model files and a reachable ComfyUI server or local mflux installation.

faq.question: Where are my prompts sent and stored?
faq.answer: ComfyUI receives prompts at your configured COMFY_URL, which defaults to localhost. The client saves prompts and generation settings beside downloaded images.

faq.question: Can I generate color images or reliable non-English notes?
faq.answer: The workflow targets monochrome ink, with configurable ink and paper colors. Handwritten notes are most reliable as short English phrases.

faq.question: Will a saved seed reproduce an image exactly?
faq.answer: Saved prompts, seeds, and settings help repeat a workflow. Exact results also depend on model files, engine versions, and processing options.
